title: Jerry Jones: We could do something at trade deadline to help the team this year

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jerry Jones: We could do something at trade deadline to help the team this year
sources.description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones talked a lot about the team being in the market for a trade addition before they swung a deal for cornerback Joey Porter Jr. at the end of September and he may not be done on that front.
